'''Fire gnats''' were [[Insect/Legends|insects]] native to [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]], with a similar [[Species/Legends|species]] found on [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. They had stingers and made a buzzing sound. Their bites produced severe burning irritation; though they were very nutritious when eaten.

[[Belvarian firegnat]]s were also similar species.
